layout: Orange header band, bordered grid, TWO line items in a table with a printed 'Total quantity 500 pairs'. A late fee (1.5% per month) and nothing else: no discount anywhere.
notes: Three fields are deliberately null. dueDate: only 'Due within 15 days of invoice date' is printed, and the product rule is never to work a date out from terms. unitPrice: the two items have different prices (900 and 650), so there is no single unit price. Both discount fields: there is no discount. A model that fills any of these in is wrong.
